name: MoneyMax Financial Services Ltd.
summary: MoneyMax Financial Services Ltd., an investment holding company, operates as a financial service provider, retailer, and trader of luxury products in Singapore and Malaysia. The company operates in four segments: Pawnbroking; Retail and Trading of Gold and Luxury Items; Secured Lending; and Others. It offers pawnbroking; retail and trading of gold jewellery, timepieces, and bags; automotive financing; property financing; and motor, travel, home, and fire insurance services. The company also engages in property owning, money lending, finance leasing, and insurance agency activities.
